# FSM_REST UML Index

**Workshop moniker:** @TrentBest  
**Purpose:** Navigate source-grounded structural diagrams and use cases. Diagrams are manually authored unless a page explicitly says otherwise; none of the pages listed here are claimed to be generated by AST/reflection or GUI.SVG.

## Architecture views

- [FSM_REST Core UML](FSM_REST.Core.UML.md) — descriptor, binding, request construction, transport, response.
- [REST request execution](RestRequestExecution.UML.md) — execution boundary and transport substitution.
- [RestApiDescriptor](RestApiDescriptorUML.md) — API description record and expected consumers.
- [RestOperationDescriptor](RestOperationDescriptor.UML.md) — reusable operation metadata.
- [RestGuiMapping](RestGuiMapping.UML.md) — presentation and host-state mapping metadata.
- [RestGuiOperationExecutor](RestGuiOperationExecutor.UML.md) — input resolution, execution, result publication.
- [RestGuiNodeFactory](RestGuiNodeFactory.UML.md) — optional Workshop GUI tree adapter.

## Coverage policy

Every production C# source file must have a neighboring Markdown companion. Each public class, record, or interface must have a focused UML page or be explicitly represented as a target in a cohesive diagram with a use-case section. Pages must identify their target, source, purpose, relationships, scope, provenance, and verification path.

## Known gap

The index is not yet a complete source-to-documentation map. Track remaining per-file companion and class UML work in [FSM_REST Documentation Readiness](../FSM_REST.DOCUMENTATION_READINESS.md). Do not interpret presence in this index as proof of complete coverage or runtime behavior.
